decisions.decision: Add a peer benchmark. Rules were pre-registered in METHOD.md before any peer data was downloaded.
Basketball-Reference is an approved source for season totals and game logs. It becomes the analysis source; the media guides become the independent check.
Scope: Butler 2011-12 to 2025-26, Murray 2016-17 to 2025-26, peers in the same seasons.
Finish this episode in daytime sessions where possible. Overnight runs only when needed, using the minimal sequential runner, not a general supervisor.
The Raphinha reel was a sample only; nothing in it is binding. The design system will be set up separately (possibly in Claude Design) before production starts.
Narrated videos are preferred for both long-form and shorts, for engagement; music-only shorts remain an option.
Approved all 11 claims in CLAIMS.json as verified (PJ-04); research locked at tag research-lock-v1.
Storyline: 'Real, but not how you think' (argument recorded in STORY.md).
Accepted the external script review plan: matched-peer check, research-lock-v2, script v2; Short C held.
Murray stays in the long film as one beat with real numbers (S06), framed as 'who looks steadier depends on the comparison'.
Script draft v2 approved; locked at tag script-lock-v1.
Design system v1 'The Fairer Test' (Claude Design) adopted; stored in studio/design-system/.
Approved installing ffmpeg (Homebrew); installed, version 9.0.2.
Run a blind Codex re-derivation of the claim values as the first overnight job (recheck/PLAN.md).
Stills approved ('the stills look good'); rectangle component H package delivered from Claude Design.
S03 proof clips approved ('the clips otherwise look good') after the dashed-line fix.
S08 verdict uses career numbers only (bars: -2.1, -1.7, -0.25), not the design's single-season rectangle.
Full set of scene stills approved ('the stills look good').

Use an AI voiceover for now. After research: Kokoro-82M (Apache-2.0 weights, commercial use allowed), run locally via mlx-audio; the top-rated open models (Breeze TTS 2, Fish Audio S2 Pro, Voxtral) and ElevenLabs' free tier forbid commercial use.
Astra (Codex) runs a final review of the script; apply its amendments and proceed to an almost-final draft video.
Voice af_heart (Kokoro's highest-rated voice); five alternatives rendered as auditions in renders/audio/audition/.
